meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 用 Astropy 进行天文与天体物理数据分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是天文学家或天体物理学家，需要处理天文数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an astronomer or astrophysicist working with astronomical data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调用 Astropy 库来处理天文数据：换算单位、转换坐标、读写 FITS 文件、操作星表、计算宇宙学距离和时间尺度等，并给出相应的 Python 代码。
howto.when: 当你要求实现或调试用 Astropy 编写的天文数据分析代码，例如涉及坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、宇宙学计算等任务时触发。

say.text: 用 Astropy 把坐标从 ICRS 转成银道坐标，给出代码
say.note: 这会生成可直接运行的转换代码。

say.text: 用 astropy.units 把 100 pc 转成 km，再告诉我结果
say.note: 输出带单位的换算结果。

say.text: 用 Planck18 算 z=1.5 的光度距离，附计算代码
say.note: 返回以 Mpc 或相应单位表示的距离。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use Astropy to handle astronomical data: convert units, transform coordinates, read/write FITS files, manipulate tables, compute cosmological distances and time scales, and provide corresponding Python code.
howto.when_en: When you ask to implement or debug astronomical data analysis code that uses Astropy, e.g., coordinate transforms, FITS I/O, or cosmological calculations.

say_en.text: Use Astropy to convert this coordinate from ICRS to Galactic, show code.
Convert 100 pc to km with astropy.units and print the result.
Compute the luminosity distance at z=1.5 with Planck18 and show the code.
